# Containment and resolution are different things

`customer_support.mm.self_service_deflection.containment_and_resolution_are_different_things` · v1.0.0 · **draft** · scope **capability** · kind **mental_model**

> Containment and resolution are different things. Containment means the contact stayed inside the self-serve channel; resolution means the problem stopped.

A channel can contain perfectly and resolve nothing — that is exactly what a dead end looks like from the outside. Vendors sell containment because it is the number their product can see.
